```sql
WITH yearly_totals AS (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE("Disbursement Date", 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS loan_year,
        SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS total_loan_amount
    FROM "shg_loan_register"
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE("Disbursement Date", 'YYYY-MM-DD')) IN (2023, 2024)
    GROUP BY loan_year
),
totals AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN loan_year = 2024 THEN total_loan_amount END) AS amount_2024,
        MAX(CASE WHEN loan_year = 2023 THEN total_loan_amount END) AS amount_2023
    FROM yearly_totals
)
SELECT
    amount_2024,
    amount_2023,
    (amount_2024 - amount_2023) * 100.0 / NULLIF(amount_2023, 0) AS percentage_growth
FROM totals;
```
